scenario.title: 跟朋友聊交友軟體和約會
scenario.context: 「那個說他是攝影師的人」「我上次見的那個男生」——聊約會對象時，我們一直在用子句描述「哪一個人」。英文的 who / which / that 關係子句就是做這件事，而且語序和中文完全相反。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: So, any luck on the apps?
lines.zh: 所以，交友軟體上有收穫嗎？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Kind of. Remember the guy who said he was a photographer?
lines.zh: 算是吧。記得那個說他是攝影師的人嗎？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: The one that had all those mountain pictures?

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Yes! We met for coffee last week, and we really hit it off.
lines.zh: 對！我們上週喝了咖啡，很聊得來。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: That's great! What about the guy who stopped replying?
lines.zh: 太好了！那個突然不回訊息的呢？

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Oh, he totally ghosted me. After three dates!
lines.zh: 喔，他完全人間蒸發了，約了三次之後！

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: That's the worst. People who ghost should just send one text. It takes ten seconds.
lines.zh: 最爛了。會搞消失的人應該傳一句話就好，只要十秒鐘。

lines.speaker: Amy
lines.en: Right? Anyway, I'm focusing on the photographer now.
lines.zh: 對吧？總之我現在專心在攝影師身上。

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Let's set up your profile. First, pick a photo that shows your face clearly.
lines.zh: 來設定你的檔案。先選一張臉很清楚的照片。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: What about the one that my friend took at the pottery studio?
lines.zh: 我朋友在陶藝教室幫我拍的那張呢？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Perfect. Now just swipe right on people you'd actually want to meet.
lines.zh: 完美。現在只對真的想見面的人往右滑。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: This guy's profile says he's a pilot who loves cooking. Too good to be true?
lines.zh: 這個人的檔案說他是愛煮飯的機師。好到不像真的？

lines.speaker: Jess
lines.en: Maybe. His photos look like stock images. Could be a catfish.
lines.zh: 有可能。他的照片看起來像圖庫照，可能是假帳號。

lines.speaker: Minz
lines.en: OK, swiping left. I'll stick to people whose photos look real.
lines.zh: 好，往左滑。我只選照片看起來真實的人。

patterns.en: What do you usually do on a first date?
patterns.zh: 你第一次約會通常做什麼？

patterns.en: It's too good to be true.
Let's just meet for coffee first.

chinglish.wrong: The say he is photographer guy.
chinglish.right: The guy who said he was a photographer.
chinglish.why: 中文把描述放在名詞前面（說他是攝影師的那個人），英文把描述放在名詞後面，用 who / that 連起來。

chinglish.wrong: I like the man who he is funny.
chinglish.right: I like guys who are funny.
chinglish.why: who 已經取代了主詞，後面不能再放 he。

chinglish.wrong: The picture which you took it is nice.
chinglish.right: The picture (that) you took is nice.
chinglish.why: which / that 已經指那張照片，後面不能再有 it。

chinglish.right: We have chemistry. / There was a spark.
chinglish.why: 「來電」直翻 electricity 母語者聽不懂。兩人有火花用 chemistry / spark。

grammar.title: 限定關係子句 who / which / that
grammar.oneLiner: 用 who（人）、which（物）、that（人或物）把描述接在名詞後面，說明「是哪一個」。
whenToUse: who：指人。The guy who ghosted me.
which：指物。The app which I use most.
that：人和物都能用，口語最常見。The one that had the mountain photos.
關係代名詞當受詞時可以省略：The photo (that) my friend took.
關係代名詞當主詞時不能省略：The guy who said…（不能說 The guy said… 當作描述）
grammar.whyWeGetItWrong: 中文的修飾語全部放在名詞前面：「那個說他是攝影師、有一堆山景照的男生」。英文正好相反，先說名詞，再用 who / that 補充。台灣人常見的錯誤是在子句裡重複主詞或受詞（the man who he…、the photo that you took it），因為中文腦會覺得句子「少了東西」。

examples.correct: I met a guy who works at a bookstore.
examples.incorrect: I met a guy who he works at a bookstore.
examples.note: who 就是主詞，不重複 he。

examples.correct: That's the café (that) we went to on our first date.
examples.note: 當受詞的 that 可以省略。

examples.correct: Apps that match you by interests are more fun.
I prefer people whose profiles are honest.
The restaurant which you recommended was amazing.
examples.incorrect: The restaurant which you recommended it was amazing.

quiz.question: I'm looking for someone ___ loves traveling.
Which is correct?
options: The app which I use it is free.
The app I use is free.
The app I use it is free.
quiz.explanation: 受詞的關係代名詞可以省略，但不能重複 it。

quiz.question: She dated a guy ___ sister is a famous singer. (…的)
Remember the restaurant ___ had the amazing dumplings?
Which is correct?
options: The man who he called me was rude.
The man who called me was rude.
The man called me who was rude.
quiz.explanation: who 取代主詞，不重複 he。

slang.meaning: （交友軟體）右滑表示喜歡；引申為「贊成、有興趣」
slang.usage: 源自 Tinder。swipe left = 沒興趣。現在也用在交友以外：I'd swipe right on that idea.

risk.note: 年輕人普遍使用，不粗俗。

examples.en: I swiped right on him because of his dog.
examples.zh: 我因為他的狗對他右滑。

examples.en: A four-day work week? I'd swipe right on that.
examples.zh: 一週上四天班？這我按讚。

slang.meaning: 突然消失、搞失蹤（不再回訊息）
slang.usage: ghost someone = 不說一聲就斷聯。也用在工作：The client ghosted us after the proposal.

risk.note: 普遍用語，但指控別人 ghost 帶抱怨。

examples.en: He ghosted me after our second date.
examples.zh: 第二次約會後他就人間蒸發了。

examples.en: The client totally ghosted us after we sent the quote.
examples.zh: 我們寄報價後，客戶就完全消失了。

slang.usage: 兩個人初次見面就很合得來。hit it off with someone。

risk.note: 用在朋友、同事、約會都可以。

examples.en: My mom and my boyfriend really hit it off.
examples.zh: 我媽和我男友很合得來。

examples.en: We hit it off right away and talked for hours.
examples.zh: 我們一見如故，聊了好幾個小時。

slang.meaning: 網路上用假身分、假照片騙人的人（或這種行為）
slang.usage: 名詞 a catfish，動詞 catfish someone / get catfished。

risk.note: 說某人是 catfish 等於指控對方詐騙，沒證據別亂說。

examples.en: His photos were from a model's Instagram. Total catfish.
examples.zh: 他的照片是從某個模特兒的 IG 抓的，根本假帳號。

examples.en: Always video chat first so you don't get catfished.
examples.zh: 先視訊，才不會被假帳號騙。

review.question: I ___ my current job in 2024.
review.explanation: 複習第 30 單元：有明確時間用過去式。

review.question: You met him on an app, ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 29 單元：過去式肯定句用 didn't you。

review.question: Do you know ___?
review.explanation: 複習第 27 單元：間接問句用肯定語序。

review.question: Would you mind ___ (take) a photo of us?
Which is correct?
options: I'm usually shy on first dates.
I usually am shy on first dates.
review.explanation: 複習第 15 單元：be 動詞後放頻率副詞。

review.question: We only met once, but we really hit it ___.
review.explanation: hit it off = 很聊得來。
